verses: I also saw the soul of a man, the skin of whose head they ever widen out, and with a cruel death they ever kill him.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers such a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is this soul of that wicked man who, in the world, slew a pious man.'
